description.zh: 给 Agent 四个办公工具：文本与 JSON 处理、只读磁盘占用扫描、系统临时目录清理（走回收站可恢复）、内存查看与工作集整理。侧边栏常驻内存占用。
description.en: Four office tools for the agent: text and JSON handling, read-only disk usage scanning, system temp cleanup (recycle bin, recoverable), and memory inspection/trimming. A sidebar panel shows live memory usage.
